mapper.select: SELECT id,batch_key,language_code,status,extraction_revision,extraction_error,created_at,deleted,deleted_at FROM recording_batch WHERE batch_key=#{batchKey} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_batch SET status=#{status}, extraction_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{batchId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE recording_batch SET extraction_revision=extraction_revision+1, extraction_error=NULL WHERE id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,file_key,batch_id,display_order,original_name,storage_key,content_type,size_bytes,sha256,status,error_code,error_detail,deleted,deleted_at FROM recording_file WHERE file_key=#{fileKey} AND deleted=FALSE

SELECT id,file_key,batch_id,display_order,original_name,storage_key,content_type,size_bytes,sha256,status,error_code,error_detail,deleted,deleted_at FROM recording_file WHERE file_key=#{fileKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,file_key,batch_id,display_order,original_name,storage_key,content_type,size_bytes,sha256,status,error_code,error_detail,deleted,deleted_at FROM recording_file WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY display_order

SELECT id,file_key,batch_id,display_order,original_name,storage_key,content_type,size_bytes,sha256,status,error_code,error_detail,deleted,deleted_at FROM recording_file WHERE status IN ('UPLOADED','TRANSCRIBING') AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_batch SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}),status='DELETED' WHERE id=#{batchId} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_file SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}),status=CASE WHEN status IN ('UPLOADED','TRANSCRIBING') THEN 'DELETE_REQUESTED' ELSE 'DELETED' END WHERE id=#{fileId} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_extracted_issue SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_issue_evidence SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}) WHERE issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM recording_extracted_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}) AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_identifier_correction SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}) WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_transcript_segment SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,#{reason}) WHERE recording_file_id=#{fileId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recording_transcript_segment(segment_key,recording_file_id,sequence_no,speaker_label,start_ms,end_ms,original_text,provider_segment_id,deleted,deleted_at,delete_reason) VALUES(#{segmentKey},#{fileId},#{sequenceNo},#{speakerLabel},#{startMs},#{endMs},#{originalText},#{providerSegmentId},#{deleted},CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN 'FILE_DELETED' ELSE NULL END)
mapper.select: SELECT id,segment_key,recording_file_id,sequence_no,speaker_label,speaker_role_code,speaker_role_confidence,speaker_role_source,start_ms,end_ms,original_text,provider_segment_id FROM recording_transcript_segment WHERE recording_file_id=#{fileId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY sequence_no

SELECT s.id,s.segment_key,s.recording_file_id,s.sequence_no,s.speaker_label,s.speaker_role_code,s.speaker_role_confidence,s.speaker_role_source,s.start_ms,s.end_ms,s.original_text,s.provider_segment_id FROM recording_transcript_segment s JOIN recording_file f ON f.id=s.recording_file_id WHERE f.batch_id=#{batchId} AND f.status='COMPLETED' AND f.deleted=FALSE AND s.deleted=FALSE ORDER BY f.display_order,s.sequence_no
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_transcript_segment SET speaker_role_code=#{roleCode},speaker_role_confidence=#{confidence},speaker_role_source=#{source} WHERE recording_file_id=#{fileId} AND speaker_label=#{speakerLabel} AND deleted=FALSE

UPDATE recording_extracted_issue SET deleted=TRUE,deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),delete_reason=COALESCE(delete_reason,'EXTRACTION_REPLACED') WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND revision=#{revision} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT id,issue_key,batch_id,revision,issue_type,content,original_content,edited_by_user,deleted,display_order,version_no,updated_at FROM recording_extracted_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND issue_key=#{issueKey}

SELECT id,issue_key,batch_id,revision,issue_type,content,original_content,edited_by_user,deleted,display_order,version_no,updated_at FROM recording_extracted_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND revision=#{revision} ORDER BY display_order

SELECT i.issue_key,f.file_key,f.original_name,s.segment_key,s.speaker_label,s.speaker_role_code,s.start_ms,s.end_ms,s.original_text,e.evidence_order FROM recording_issue_evidence e JOIN recording_extracted_issue i ON i.id=e.issue_id JOIN recording_transcript_segment s ON s.id=e.segment_id JOIN recording_file f ON f.id=s.recording_file_id WHERE i.batch_id=#{batchId} AND i.revision=#{revision} AND e.deleted=FALSE AND f.deleted=FALSE AND s.deleted=FALSE ORDER BY i.display_order,e.evidence_order
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_extracted_issue SET content=#{content},edited_by_user=TRUE,version_no=version_no+1 WHERE id=#{issueId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}

UPDATE recording_extracted_issue SET deleted=#{deleted},deleted_at=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END,delete_reason=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN 'USER_DELETED_ITEM' ELSE NULL END,version_no=version_no+1 WHERE id=#{issueId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,correction_key,batch_id,revision,issue_id,field_type,original_value,suggested_value,model_value,source_text,evidence_segment_ids_json,candidates_json,rule_score,score_margin,reason,status,confirmed_at FROM recording_identifier_correction WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND revision=#{revision} AND deleted=FALSE

SELECT id,correction_key,batch_id,revision,issue_id,field_type,original_value,suggested_value,model_value,source_text,evidence_segment_ids_json,candidates_json,rule_score,score_margin,reason,status,confirmed_at FROM recording_identifier_correction WHERE issue_id=#{issueId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_identifier_correction SET status=#{status},confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{correctionId} AND status IN ('LLM_PENDING_CONFIRMATION','MANUAL_INPUT_REQUIRED')
UPDATE recording_identifier_correction SET status='MANUAL_EDIT',confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE issue_id=#{issueId} AND status IN ('LLM_PENDING_CONFIRMATION','MANUAL_INPUT_REQUIRED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recording_identifier_correction WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND revision=#{revision} AND deleted=FALSE AND status IN ('LLM_PENDING_CONFIRMATION','MANUAL_INPUT_REQUIRED')
mapper.update: UPDATE recording_extracted_issue SET content=#{content},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE id=#{issueId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}
